description: Consolidate the discriminator assignment: adenine-reading side chains in 1RGO and the E195 to A3 distance distribution across the 20 models
code:
# ============================================================================
# Iteration 2, analysis 4: consolidate. Criterion 1 passed in finger 1 only,
# so measure directly how far the finger-2 equivalent (E195) sits from the
# adenine it should read by symmetry (A3), across all 20 models.
# ============================================================================
import collections
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

RNA_BB = {"P","OP1","OP2","O5'","C5'","C4'","O4'","C3'","O3'","C2'","O2'","C1'"}
MAIN = {"N","CA","C","O","OXT"}
txt = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1RGO.pdb", timeout=120).text
models = collections.defaultdict(list); cur = None
for line in txt.split("\n"):
    if line.startswith("MODEL"): cur = int(line.split()[1])
    elif line.startswith("ENDMDL"): cur = None
    elif cur and line.startswith("ATOM"):
        if (line[76:78].strip() or line[12:16].strip()[0]) == "H": continue
        models[cur].append((line[21], int(line[22:26]), line[17:20].strip(), line[12:16].strip(),
                            float(line[30:38]), float(line[38:46]), float(line[46:54])))

CONTACT = [153,155,156,157,158,159,160,161,168,169,170,173,174,175,176,
           191,193,194,195,196,197,198,199,206,207,208,211,212,213,214]
# side-chain to adenine-base minimum distance, per model
rec = collections.defaultdict(list)
for mi, atoms in models.items():
    prot = [a for a in atoms if a[0] == "A"]
    adeni = {3: [a for a in atoms if a[0] == "D" and a[1] == 3 and a[3] not in RNA_BB],
             7: [a for a in atoms if a[0] == "D" and a[1] == 7 and a[3] not in RNA_BB]}
    for r in CONTACT:
        sc = [a for a in prot if a[1] == r and a[3] not in MAIN]
        if not sc: continue
        for an, aat in adeni.items():
            d = np.linalg.norm(np.array([a[4:7] for a in sc])[:, None]
                               - np.array([a[4:7] for a in aat])[None], axis=2).min()
            rec[(r, an)].append(d)

summ = []
for (r, an), ds in rec.items():
    summ.append({"residue": r, "adenine": f"A{an}", "median_min_dist_A": float(np.median(ds)),
                 "frac_models_under_4A": float(np.mean(np.array(ds) < 4.0)),
                 "frac_models_under_5A": float(np.mean(np.array(ds) < 5.0))})
S = pd.DataFrame(summ)
best = S.sort_values("median_min_dist_A").head(12)
print("closest side chains to an adenine base, median over 20 models")
print(best.to_string(index=False))
S.to_csv("adenine_sidechain_distances.csv", index=False)

e157 = np.array(rec[(157, 7)]); e195 = np.array(rec[(195, 3)])
print(f"\nE157 side chain to A7 base: median {np.median(e157):.2f} A, "
      f"range {e157.min():.2f}-{e157.max():.2f}, <4 A in {int((e157<4).sum())}/20 models")
print(f"E195 side chain to A3 base: median {np.median(e195):.2f} A, "
      f"range {e195.min():.2f}-{e195.max():.2f}, <4 A in {int((e195<4).sum())}/20 models, "
      f"<5 A in {int((e195<5).sum())}/20")
print(f"E195 side chain to A7 base: median {np.median(rec[(195,7)]):.2f} A")
print(f"E157 side chain to A3 base: median {np.median(rec[(157,3)]):.2f} A")

# every position, best adenine distance, to show C1-2 is the unique adenine reader
pos_label = {153:"ZF1 C1-6",155:"ZF1 C1-4",156:"ZF1 C1-3",157:"ZF1 C1-2",158:"ZF1 C1-1",
             159:"ZF1 C1+0",160:"ZF1 C1+1",161:"ZF1 C1+2",168:"ZF1 C2+0",169:"ZF1 C2+1",
             170:"ZF1 C2+2",173:"ZF1 C3-1",174:"ZF1 C3+0",175:"ZF1 C3+1",176:"ZF1 C3+2",
             191:"ZF2 C1-6",193:"ZF2 C1-4",194:"ZF2 C1-3",195:"ZF2 C1-2",196:"ZF2 C1-1",
             197:"ZF2 C1+0",198:"ZF2 C1+1",199:"ZF2 C1+2",206:"ZF2 C2+0",207:"ZF2 C2+1",
             208:"ZF2 C2+2",211:"ZF2 C3-1",212:"ZF2 C3+0",213:"ZF2 C3+1",214:"ZF2 C3+2"}
cog = S.groupby("residue")["median_min_dist_A"].min().reindex(CONTACT)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5))
c = ["#b03030" if r in (157, 195) else "#9fb3c8" for r in CONTACT]
ax[0].bar(range(len(CONTACT)), cog.values, color=c)
ax[0].axhline(4.0, ls="--", c="k", lw=0.8)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(CONTACT)))
ax[0].set_xticklabels([pos_label[r] for r in CONTACT], rotation=90, fontsize=7)
ax[0].set_ylabel("median side-chain distance to the nearest adenine base (A)")
ax[0].set_title("Only the C1-2 position approaches an adenine base\n(red, 20-model median; dashed line at 4 A)")
ax[1].boxplot([e157, e195, np.array(rec[(157,3)]), np.array(rec[(195,7)])],
              labels=["E157 to A7", "E195 to A3", "E157 to A3", "E195 to A7"])
ax[1].axhline(4.0, ls="--", c="k", lw=0.8)
ax[1].set_ylabel("side-chain to base minimum distance (A)")
ax[1].set_title("The two C1-2 glutamates across the 20 NMR models:\nfinger 1 reads its adenine closely, finger 2 more loosely")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
